emulate_int: emulate integer quantization on a tensor using a specified method like histogram, channel, or tensor
quantize: quantize a tensor using a given scale, zero point, and bit width with clamping
emulate_int8_histogram: emulate 8-bit integer quantization using a histogram observer to compute scale and zero point
emulate_int8_channel: emulate per-channel 8-bit integer quantization using a per-channel min-max observer
emulate_int8_tensor: emulate 8-bit integer quantization using a min-max observer to compute scale and zero point
